svg.title: Claymark icon (outline / single-ink)
svg.desc: One color, stroke only, no fill — for contexts needing a single-ink mark that survives on any background color: an embossed/engraved treatment, a letterhead watermark, a single-color print run. Uses currentColor so the consuming context sets the one ink color rather than this file assuming light-on-dark or dark-on-light.
